art_direction: 露脸的伊之助穿深蓝亚麻衣，在山坡整理野餐包。
composition_variation: Feature Inosuke Hashibira with his recognizable dark teal hair and clear expressive face, wearing a fully covering deep blue linen shirt and loose trousers. He sits cross-legged beside a neatly tied picnic bundle on a mountain meadow. Place his boar mask nowhere in the scene. Use fresh green gouache, distant lavender ridges, bright midday light, and an unusually content, curious expression. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved in Codex local artifact directory anime-wallpapers-100/native. Final wallpaper is cropped and resized, not generated natively at final dimensions.
